Implementation Plan

Planning ref
- HEAD: `304bde605dad13f9029cfd457f466114b9078f9b`
- Checkout ref: `orchestrator/project-2373`
- Integration metadata: `orchestrator/project-2373`
- Result: ref matches integration metadata, so planning can proceed.

Clarification interpretation
- No Q1/Q2 clarification batch was issued for this issue.
- The only follow-up was `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]`, which just confirms “proceed with the issue body as written.”
- Source of truth for this plan is therefore the issue description plus current repo state.

Representative patterns to follow
- Workflow/bootstrap pattern: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
  - It already stages `install_semble.sh` / `semble_helpers.sh`, initializes `SEMBLE_*` runtime env defaults, and uses gated `Setup uv` / `Install semble` / `Build semble index` steps with fail-open behavior.
  - `orchestrate_poll.yml` should mirror that style rather than invent a new Semble bootstrap shape.
- Prompt-side Semble query pattern: `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`
  - It builds a small bounded query file, calls `scripts/semble_helpers.sh::semble_query_block`, and appends the returned block after the prompt body.
  - Judge-family prompt builders should follow this pattern.
- Static-prefix boundary to preserve: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::assemble_judge_static_context`
  - Semble must not be injected into `judge_static.txt` / `pre_assembled_static.txt`.
  - It belongs in the per-invocation dynamic prompt assembly only.

Conflicts / codebase facts to carry into implementation
- The issue summary understates one live consumer: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` already renders `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt` for the combined orchestrator review-blocked judge path, in addition to `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`. The Semble wiring must cover both paths.
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` currently has no Semble bootstrap/runtime env support at all. The workflow work here is additive, not a small tweak to an existing Semble path.
- The issue’s assumption about review workflow support is already satisfied on this ref: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` already stages/install/indexes Semble, so this issue should not touch that file.

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  - Add workflow/job Semble defaults and staged helper availability for poller runs.
  - Stage `install_semble.sh` and `semble_helpers.sh` from workflow support checkout, ideally with the same backward-compatible fail-open treatment used in `review_autofix.yml`.
  - Add gated `Setup uv`, `Install semble`, and `Build semble index` steps before `Process each tracking issue`.
  - Export runtime defaults such as `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE`, `SEMBLE_BIN`, `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE`, and `SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH=${RUNTIME_DIR}/.semble-index` so downstream scripts can fail open cleanly.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
  - Source `scripts/semble_helpers.sh` if present.
  - Add one shared local helper path for building a bounded judge Semble query and capturing a Semble prefetch block.
  - Wire that block into all live judge-family prompt builders in this file:
    - main orchestrator judge using `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
    - stall judge using `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`
    - combined/orchestrator review-blocked judge using `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`
    - inline integration-conflict judge prompt assembly
- `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`
  - Source `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}/semble_helpers.sh` fail-open.
  - Build a bounded review-blocked Semble query/context block from the existing PR + issue context already available in the script.
  - Pass that block into the rendered prompt.
- `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
  - Add support for a second standalone placeholder: `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`.
  - Preserve the existing explicit unresolved-placeholder guard style by adding a second explicit post-render check for this placeholder, rather than broad placeholder stripping.
- `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
  - Insert `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` as a standalone line near the top of the task body, before the criteria/rules sections.
- `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`
  - Insert the same standalone placeholder near the prompt header, before the deeper decision/rules sections.
- `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`
  - Insert the same standalone placeholder near the prompt header, before the action guidance/rules sections.
- `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py`
  - New focused contract test covering placeholder/render wiring and poller bootstrap wiring.

Out of scope / do not change
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt`
- any new prompt consumer wiring for `mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt`
- `scripts/install_semble.sh` / `scripts/semble_helpers.sh` unless implementation proves impossible without touching them

2. Functions or modules to implement
- `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
  - Extend the existing placeholder switch so it recognizes both:
    - `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}`
    - `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`
  - Keep placeholder matching line-based. The new prompt placeholder should remain on its own line in templates so the current render model still applies cleanly.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
  - Keep `assemble_judge_static_context` unchanged for Semble purposes.
  - Add a local helper or helper pair for:
    - building a bounded Semble query text from already-available judge inputs
    - calling `semble_query_block` fail-open and capturing stdout
  - Reuse that helper for each prompt builder rather than duplicating slightly different Semble blocks in four places.
  - For the inline integration-conflict judge, append the returned Semble block directly in shell at the prompt assembly site instead of introducing a new template file.
- `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`
  - Add an analogous local Semble query/prefetch helper, but point it at support scripts (`${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}`) rather than repo-local `scripts/`.
  - When rendering `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`, pass the prebuilt block via environment so `render_prompt.sh` can substitute it.
- Prompt templates
  - Add the placeholder only; do not otherwise reshape the prompts.
  - Keep the insertion point stable and consistent across all three templates.

3. Data structures affected
- Prompt-template contract
  - New placeholder token: `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`
  - It should be treated like `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}`: standalone line, rendered away entirely when empty.
- Runtime environment / job state
  - `SEMBLE_ENABLED`
  - `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE`
  - `SEMBLE_BIN`
  - `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE`
  - `SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH`
  - `SEMBLE_PREFETCH` as the per-render dynamic text block passed into `render_prompt.sh`
- Ephemeral runtime artifacts
  - Temporary/local query text and Semble context strings/files under `RUNTIME_DIR` for each judge prompt family
  - These should stay transient only; no schema, state-file, or memory-record format changes are needed
- No persistent JSON schema changes
  - `STATE_FILE`, orchestrator state comments, and AI memory schemas should remain unchanged for this issue

4. API or interface changes
- Internal interface change only:
  - `scripts/render_prompt.sh` gains support for `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`
- Prompt consumer contract change:
  - judge-family prompt builders can now optionally inject a bounded Semble block when rendering those templates
- Workflow interface:
  - no new `workflow_call` inputs are needed for `orchestrate_poll.yml`
  - no external/user-facing CLI changes are required
- Optional env knobs:
  - if the editor chooses to add per-judge chunk-count overrides, they must be optional and default locally; do not create a required new repo variable for this issue
- No new prompt consumers:
  - the inline integration-conflict judge remains inline
  - `prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt` remains unused

5. Potential risks or edge cases
- Static-prefix caching regression
  - The Semble block must not be added to `assemble_judge_static_context` or any preassembled static artifact.
  - It should remain in the dynamic per-prompt assembly path only.
- Incomplete consumer coverage
  - If the implementation wires only `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` and misses the orchestrator-side combined review-blocked path in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, behavior will be inconsistent.
- Fail-open behavior
  - Disabled Semble, missing helper scripts, missing index, empty Semble results, or Semble timeouts must all collapse to “no Semble block” without breaking judge execution.
- Backward-compatible support bootstrap
  - `orchestrate_poll.yml` fetches support files from runtime workflow refs. Treating new helpers as hard-required could break older support refs unexpectedly.
  - Mirror the review workflow’s optional/fail-open bootstrap style where possible.
- Prompt-size / cache-span pressure
  - The main judge and integration-conflict judge already carry large context blocks.
  - Keep the Semble prefetch bounded and conservative so it does not swamp existing diff/status sections.
- Subshell/env propagation
  - `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` renders prompts from a subshell rooted at `${SUPPORT_ROOT_DIR}`; ensure the Semble placeholder value is exported/passed so `render_prompt.sh` sees it there.
- Placeholder hygiene
  - The templates must place `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` on its own line.
  - `render_prompt.sh` should explicitly error only if the placeholder survives rendering, not silently leave braces in output.

6. Testing considerations
- Add `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py` as the focused contract test for this issue.
  - It should verify at least:
    - `scripts/render_prompt.sh` contains `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` handling and an explicit unresolved-placeholder guard
    - all three live judge prompt templates contain the new placeholder
    - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` no
